channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-ai-in-finance
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: wallstreetype-research — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Agent-agnostic equity-research pipeline that turns sell-side report methodology into runnable code: a dual-market data layer (US / A-share), institutional chart families, six layout templates, and Markdown-to-Word/PDF report production.

item.title: signal8ai/signal8-mcp — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Official Signal8 MCP server: small-cap dilution (warrants, ATMs, shelf registrations, convertibles, cash runway) with each figure cited to its SEC filing, plus insider and congressional trades, halts and reverse splits. Requires a Signal8 Pro API key.

item.title: seduma-trade-agent-demo — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Practice-only loop that runs LLM trading-agent decisions through confirm-gated simulated fills.

item.title: multi-agent-investment — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Multi-agent equity research with three reasoning modes and deterministic signal fusion; decisions are reproducible from a pure-function core, with an offline demo that needs no API keys.

item.title: kburrus64-max/prop-firm-rules — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Prop-firm risk rules MCP server (FTMO, Topstep, Apex and more): sourced daily-loss and max-drawdown limits plus a drawdown-room check for trading agents. Stdio or free hosted endpoint, no API key.

item.title: financial-reports/financial-reports-mcp-server — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Official FinancialFilings MCP server: annual and interim reports, ad-hoc disclosures and ESEF/XBRL filings from securities regulators in about 60 markets, with XBRL financials and company identifiers. Free with a registered account (OAuth).

item.title: US Bank Data — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Open Python package for selected FDIC institution financial snapshots and multi-bank quarterly panels with explicit units and archived source evidence.

item.title: TRA (bitra) — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Autonomous crypto trading system in which LLM agents only propose: deterministic rules compute every figure, price costs before any order, size from the operator's risk limit, keep exits at the exchange, and record every decision with a re-verifiable hash.

item.title: StockTipsArena — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: AI-extracted Indian equity (NSE) analyst recommendation tracker, SEBI registry directory, and stock screener auditing 27,000+ public calls against exchange OHLCV candles, with an open CC BY 4.0 benchmark dataset (GitHub) and MCP server (GitHub). Free tier available.

item.title: SmartMoney-Cub — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Read-only trading journal and review harness for agents: freezes point-in-time evidence packs, replays them deterministically, and grades rule candidates on a frozen 240-case finance benchmark. MIT.

item.title: LLM_trader — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: An LLM trading agent that reads a chart rendered from every closed candle, retrieves its own closed trades as memory, and publishes every prompt, decision and loss; paper trading with a ledger the repo can reproduce.

item.title: Kernel-Hunter/kandle — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Open-source browser charting app with an MCP server: agents read the chart, draw levels, add indicators and alerts, and run strategy backtests on crypto, stocks and forex.

item.title: FriesTrader — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Claude Code template for automated live orders through Robinhood Agentic Trading MCP, with rule-based position sizing and trade limits. Requires an eligible Robinhood Agentic Trading account.

item.title: FinTwin — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Open source digital twin of 390+ public companies' finances built from SEC XBRL filings, with Monte Carlo stress tests, conformal forecast intervals and an out-of-sample backtest on 5,000+ SEC filers. Live dashboard and paper included.

item.title: EcoFinLearn — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Free in-browser Python, pandas, scikit-learn and SQL lessons for finance and economics students, including return prediction with scikit-learn; runs on Pyodide and SQLite with no signup.

item.title: Beltran12138/evidence-deflator — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Open-source MCP server and Python library that checks how much of an LLM trading backtest falls before the model's training cutoff and how many clean months a claimed Sharpe needs after selection; publishes an evidence-adjusted leaderboard of public AI trading competitions.

item.title: AlphaFinch — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: AlphaEvolve-style agent that invents and evolves trading strategies as code, then grades them on sealed holdouts and a pre-registered multi-market exam; no brokerage connection.

item.title: tradefloor — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Simulated stock markets with a limit order book per company and an economy underneath, for testing RL policies and LLM trading agents, with a Gymnasium environment and adapters for the OpenAI Agents SDK, PydanticAI and LangGraph.

item.title: tracemodel — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Python library for financial models that AI agents fill from filings: every number has a source, formulas are traced, and checks catch totals that do not tie.

item.title: oracle3 — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Prediction-market trading engine and MCP server for Kalshi, Polymarket, and Solana, with fee-aware no-arbitrage checks across related contracts and live or paper execution.

item.title: lumibot — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Python framework for backtesting and live trading with the same strategy code, with a built-in AI agent runtime and 12 broker integrations across stocks, options, futures, forex, crypto and prediction markets.

item.title: itulo/eu-nordic-open-data-mcp — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Open-source MCP server for official EU open data: ECB FX rates, policy rates and HICP inflation, EU consolidated sanctions screening, VIES VAT validation, and GLEIF LEI ownership chains. No API key for these tools; same tools also available as pay-per-use Apify actors.

item.title: firecrawl/firecrawl-mcp-server — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Official Firecrawl MCP server for finance research agents: web search, scrape, and crawl, plus Alexandria providers for SEC EDGAR filings and FRED macro series. Alexandria requires an API key.

item.title: autorekt — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: CLI and agent skill that give AI agents market data from free public sources: cross-asset prices, dollar liquidity, swap spreads, positioning, options gamma, China money markets and prediction-market odds, with the age of every value.

item.title: What LLM Trading Agents Actually Do in Production: A Six-Month, Population-Scale Record from Two Fleets, 2026 — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Six months of production behavior from two LLM trading fleets, DX Terminal Pro and DXAP, with paper artifacts and aggregate data on GitHub.

item.title: TokenSonar — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Institutional adoption scores (0-100) for cryptocurrencies built from spot-ETF assets, institutional partners, news and on-chain real-world-asset value; free JSON download with published methodology, updated twice daily.

item.title: Resolved Markets — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Historical Polymarket order book snapshots, trades and resolutions via REST, WebSocket and a hosted MCP server, plus Hyperliquid perp books. Free tier covers crypto markets.

item.title: PredixLab Signals — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Python research pipeline for daily US equity signals (S&P 500 / Nasdaq-100): LightGBM with purged walk-forward validation, next-session backtests with per-side costs, and leakage tests. Daily data only; not live quotes.

item.title: Operating-Layer Controls for Onchain Language-Model Agents Under Real Capital, 2026 — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: 21-day deployment of 3,505 user-funded LLM agents trading real ETH on Base, measuring how controls outside the model change agent behavior.

item.title: Krexa — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Agent skill and remote MCP server for turning a trading idea, post or video into fixed rules, backtesting and paper-trading them free, and requesting a user-approved live trading agent on Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, OKX, Bybit, MEXC, Hyperliquid, Polymarket and Solana DEXs.

item.title: FastTrade AI — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Signal-only LLM market research workspace with deterministic risk checks, a budgeted batch API, and reproducible checksummed backtests. Never places orders.

item.title: DXAP — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Agentic trading harness on Hyperliquid by DX Research Group: write a strategy in plain language, an AI agent trades your own account inside limits a policy engine enforces, and every decision is logged.

item.title: CAST — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Cross-asset Kalman filtering with model predictive control for limiting portfolio drawdown (ICDM 2026).

item.title: Agents Finance — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Free bilingual (EN/ES) directory of real AI-agent use cases in accounting, FP&A, treasury and ERPs, with sources, evidence level and copyable prompts.

item.title: livetennisapi/livetennisapi-mcp — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Open-source MCP server for tennis scores, fixtures, rankings, and win probabilities for prediction-market research. API plan limits apply.

item.title: heubme2020/datasinking — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Open-source MCP server for Asian financial reports as Markdown, with chapter-level access. Requires a DataSinking API key; usage limits apply.

item.title: financeskills — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Agent skills for financial reporting, audit, reconciliation, journal entries, and accounting workflows referencing IFRS and GAAP.

item.title: ai-agent-playbook — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Knowledge base and runnable experiments on AI agent engineering, quantitative finance, and LLM-based factor research.

item.title: The Stall — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Pay-per-call API and MCP service aggregating stock, macroeconomic, crypto, and prediction-market data from third-party sources.

item.title: SPZCO — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Research terminal for U.S. congressional trades, executive disclosures, institutional holdings, and insider filings, with links to source documents.

item.title: Quant Research — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Agent skill for backtest validation using parameter stability, selection-bias checks, and walk-forward evaluation.

item.title: PineTS — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Open-source Pine Script transpiler and runtime for indicators and strategies in Node.js and browsers, using live or custom market data.

item.title: OpenCandle — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Open-source financial research agent with real-time market data, local portfolios and watchlists, and no trade execution.

item.title: Nova-TradingAgent — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Self-hosted A-share research workbench built on TradingAgents, with a web interface and no brokerage connection by default.

item.title: Market Brief — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Agent skill for source-linked funding and liquidity briefs, preserving observation dates and missing-data states.

item.title: Live Tennis API — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Tennis scores, win probabilities, and historical match results for prediction-market research via REST and WebSocket. History and advanced features require paid plans.

item.title: Edgrapi — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Metered REST API and hosted MCP service for SEC filings, insider trades, institutional holdings, and company fundamentals. API key required.

item.title: EarningsCall — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: API and SDKs for earnings call transcripts, audio, and presentation slides, with speaker identification and Q&A segmentation.

item.title: Bargo Congress API — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Agent skill for querying U.S. congressional trade disclosures by ticker, member, chamber, transaction type, and date.

item.title: AgentServices — via awesome-ai-in-finance
item.description: Crypto market data, on-chain analytics, and FX data via REST and MCP, with free endpoints and metered paid access.
